purpose: Prepare deterministic, claim-grounded replacements for broken Lupine Science article videos without treating generative video as evidence.

productionTiers.useWhen: The visual and narrative package remains valid but audio, encode, caption, poster, or packaging gates fail.
Existing article images and code graphics can communicate the approved article without synthetic motion footage.
The current film fails mechanism specificity, hierarchy, typography, transitions, or scene structure.
productionTiers.generationAllowed: still images only after a demonstrated gap and with non-evidence classification

productionTiers.useWhen: A specific approved scene cannot be produced from existing media, deterministic graphics, authored stills, compositing, or structured 3D.
productionTiers.generationAllowed: requires owner approval per shot and may not depict quantitative evidence, frozen economics, measured results, or unverified claims

sceneRules.speculativeVisuals: must be explicitly classified as illustration and may not impersonate results, instruments, simulations, deployments, or forecasts

colorDirection.domainRoles: Candidates may add article-specific domain colors, but every added role must have one declared scientific meaning.
colorDirection.sceneRule: Every scene declares at least one semantic color role used by its dominant proof.
colorDirection.textContrast: WCAG AA with zero strict HyperFrames contrast warnings.
colorDirection.nonColorRedundancy: Labels, geometry, position, or motion must preserve every distinction without color.
prohibitions: color may not encode unsupported magnitude, probability, confidence, or epistemic state

delivery.audio: AAC mono 44.1 kHz, -16 LUFS target, LRA <= 8 LU, true peak <= -1 dBTP
delivery.captions: UTF-8 WebVTT, monotonic, non-overlapping, synchronized to verified narration
delivery.poster: 1920x1080 review poster; publication derivative per repository builder

publicationGate: No replacement may overwrite public/videos, merge, deploy, or be called final until repository gates, independent reviewer PASS, director APPROVE, owner approval, PR, and CI all pass.
